source: AAA gasprices.aaa.com national average, May 22 2026 ($4.552 — 'Today's AAA National Average $4.552, Price as of 5/22/26'). +52.2% above $2.99 Feb 28 baseline; ~$1.38/gal above year-ago levels; just 9¢ below the June 2022 all-time record of $4.61. Heading into Memorial Day weekend AAA forecasts a record 45M Americans travelling ≥50 miles (39.1M by car, 3.66M by air) — Stacey Barber, VP AAA Travel: 'Travel demand remains strong, and despite higher fuel prices, many people are prioritizing leisure travel during holiday breaks.' California highest at $6.14; Washington $5.78; Hawaii $5.64; Mississippi lowest at $4.01. LendingTree: nationwide gas prices up 43.6% YoY, with Ohio +57.2%, New Hampshire +56%, Michigan +53.8% among the biggest 12-month state jumps on record. Trump 05-11 federal gas-tax suspension (18.4¢) still in legislative pipeline; no enactment through 05-22.
